changelog:
- Major rewrite: Now controls QQ Music macOS client via MediaRemote private framework.
- New Python script (qq_music.py) replaces Node.js/JS/cdp-based controller.
- Removes dependency on browser automation/CDP/DevTools and web player.
- No longer requires Accessibility or AppleScript permissions.
- Supports commands: play/pause, next/prev, random, volume up/down, status check.
- Now works on macOS with only Python 3 and QQ Music installed; no extra dependencies needed.
summary: 控制 macOS QQ 音乐客户端播放、暂停、下一首、随机播放等
